name: Navigation drawer
statusNote: Width grew from the classic 280dp max to 360dp, and shape/elevation moved onto tokens.
summary: Standard drawers sit alongside content permanently or dismissibly for frequent, deliberate navigation; modal drawers overlay content behind a scrim for infrequent access on compact layouts. MDC-Android marks this component deprecated in Expressive, recommending an expanded navigation rail instead; ship it for parity with existing apps, not for new designs.

inputs.name: drawerContent
inputs.description: The drawer sheet's content: headline(s) and items.

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: The screen content the drawer sits beside or overlays.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: permanent has no open/close state at all; dismissible toggles in/out of layout via a menu icon; modal overlays content with a scrim.

inputs.name: open
inputs.description: Dismissible and modal only: whether the drawer is currently shown. The caller owns it.

inputs.name: selected
inputs.description: Per-item: whether this destination is the active one.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: The drawer sheet; fixed width, full height.

anatomy.name: Headline
anatomy.description: Optional section label above a group of items.

anatomy.name: Item
anatomy.description: One destination row: icon, label, optional badge.

anatomy.name: Active indicator
anatomy.description: Pill behind the selected item's icon+label.

anatomy.name: Scrim
anatomy.description: Modal only; dims content behind the open drawer.

variants.description: Always visible, content reflows beside it (a row composition, no open/close state).
Toggles in/out of layout via a menu icon, content reflows.
Overlays content with a scrim, opened by gesture or icon, dismissed by scrim tap, swipe, or Escape.

layout.text: Container width is fixed at 360dp; Compose enforces this as a maximum and clamps drag gestures to it. A 240dp minimum width floor is used only while measuring, not a token.
Standard container: a large-end rounded corner shape applies to the trailing corners only (leading corners square, flush with the screen edge).
Item active indicator is 56dp tall, 336dp wide — narrower than the container to leave a margin; shape is a full pill.
Item internal padding is 16dp leading / 24dp trailing inset around the icon+label row, with a 12dp gap between icon and label and between label and badge. Not tokenized.
Modal drawer elevation is level0 (shadow comes from the scrim, not container elevation); permanent/dismissible standard drawers render at level0 or level1 depending on container colour context.

states.text: One item selected at a time; the selected item gets the active indicator and active-* icon/label colors; unselected items use inactive-* colors.
Hover, focus, and pressed variants exist for both active and inactive items, each recoloring icon and label only; the indicator shape is unchanged by interaction state.
A separate ring/outline in the focus-indicator colour is drawn around the item on keyboard focus, distinct from the hover/press state layer.

states.label: drag-to-dismiss
states.text: Modal only: the drawer is a horizontal anchored-drag surface with two anchors, closed and open. A positional threshold of 50% of travel distance, or a velocity threshold of 400dp/s, crossing either commits the drawer to the nearer/flung-toward anchor on release. Drag can be disabled via gesturesEnabled.

Modal only: the scrim uses sys.color.scrim at fixed opacity; its alpha is driven directly by drag/animation progress (0 closed to full open), not a separate fade timeline. Tapping the scrim while open closes the drawer.

Open animates with a default-spatial spring; close animates with a fast-effects spring — open and close are intentionally asymmetric (slower spatial spring in, snappier effects spring out). The live drag itself snaps anchors using the same default-spatial spring. A permanent drawer has no open/close motion — it is always laid out.

states.label: close-motion
states.text: Close animates with a fast-effects spring.

behaviour.text: Scrim tap, drag past threshold, and the Escape key all close a modal drawer; a permanent drawer has no dismiss path.
On open, keyboard focus moves to the first focusable element inside the drawer content.
Modal and dismissible drawers share one open/closed state model; permanent drawers carry no state at all — they are just a fixed-width row sibling to content.

keyboard: Focus is trapped/moved to the drawer's first element on open and should return to the invoking control on close.
Tab moves through items in document order.
semantics: Modal drawer content is exposed as a dismissible pane (paneTitle "Navigation menu", with a dismiss semantic action when open); items expose role tab with selected state.
Minimum touch target: item row height matches the 56dp active-indicator height end to end, meeting the 48dp minimum with margin.
Screen reader announces the item's label, selected state, and any badge value; the drawer itself announces as a navigation pane when it opens.

notes.text: The active indicator width (336) is intentionally less than the full container width (360) minus its horizontal margin — do not stretch it edge to edge.
Container shape only rounds the trailing corners (large-end); do not apply this shape to a bottom/full-screen drawer variant, which instead needs a top-rounded bottom-container-shape for that layout.

Because MDC-Android flags this component as deprecated in favor of the expanded navigation rail, treat new-token additions here cautiously — the spec may not receive further Expressive-era investment upstream.
